Overbidding risks paying more than your value if you win; underbidding risks losing when the second price is below your value. With v = 30 and two independent rivals, bidding exactly 30 maximizes expected profit. Ties are random; I won’t exceed my value to break ties. [ This is a second-price auction with independent private values. The dominant strategy is truthful bidding: bid your exact value. Underbidding risks losing profitable wins (when the second-highest bid is below your value). Overbidding risks winning and paying above value if the second-highest bid lies between your value and your bid. With value 25, the profit-maximizing bid is 25.
